import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; x=df['x'].values; v=df['v'].values; a=df['dv_dt'].values
def model(p):
    w=p[0]; C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    static=p[1]+p[2]*x+p[3]*v+p[4]*np.exp(-v)+p[5]/v+p[6]*x**3+p[7]*np.sin(v)
    drive=C*(p[8]+p[9]*v+p[10]*x)+S*(p[11]+p[12]*v+p[13]*x)
    return static+drive
def resid(p): return model(p)-a
best=None
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for k in range(30):
    p0=np.concatenate([[rng.uniform(0.38,0.45)],rng.normal(0,1,13)])
    r=least_squares(resid,p0,max_nfev=3000)
    e=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(a)
    if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,r.x)
print(best[0]); print(np.round(best[1],4))
